research_question: Does passing delayed loss gradients through an automatically learned binary predictive belief across full observable histories improve next-observation generalization relative to blocked one-step credit, transition learning ablation and strong equally trained conventional predictors?
claim_scope: PUBLIC DEVELOPMENT; state is a designed two-latent-state Bayesian filter with parameters learned from public histories, NOT novel discovered architecture or independent held-out scientific transfer.

families.A_SWITCH_AND_RETAIN: hidden binary latent; initial hidden fair; at t action0 flip probability .04, action1 flip .72; sensor accuracy .83; publicly observed (o_t,a_t,o_t+1), with hidden NEVER sent to learners
families.B_LAGGED_CAUSAL_ACTION: hidden binary latent; hidden flip probability .76 if previous public action1 and current public action0, else .06; sensor accuracy .75; previous action is observable from public history but the candidate filter uses only current action directly; explicit model mismatch tests representational insufficiency
families.C_SENSOR_REGIME_DRIFT: hidden binary latent; flip probability .13 for public action0 and .62 for action1; emission sensor accuracy .93 on even t and .61 on odd t, timestep parity public via sequence position but the candidate assumes stationary emission; tests insufficiency of stationary learned representations
families.NULL_IID: public next observation iid fair bit and public action iid fair; no causal signal

learners.FULL_CREDIT_BELIEF: 5 learned logits (emission0,emission1,flip_action0,flip_action1,initial_prior). At each public step filter current observation with Bayes, transition by current public action, predict next observation. Episode-mean NLL gradient by central finite difference epsilon .0001 THROUGH the complete 28-step recurrent belief. 24 epochs, minibatch 8, Adam lr .02, clip global norm 2. Starts 17/31, SELECT-only seed choice.
learners.STOP_CREDIT_BELIEF: Identical forward-filter, exact same 5 parameters and optimization budget but train gradient for each public next-bit forecast holds its PRE-observation latent prior from the unperturbed model constant (no gradient through earlier observations/transitions). All current-step gradient paths remain. This is explicit truncated one-step credit ablation.
learners.FROZEN_TRANSITION_BELIEF: Same FULL gradient and model except both transition logits held fixed at their seed initialization. Fit emissions/initial prior; controls necessity of learning action dynamics.
learners.O4_BATCH_ACTION_HMM_EM: Verbatim original O4 model source Git blob 3ab09e0b9b27a3404ddaf81fdc3c26cc87ba7a4c, original 12 EM rounds starts 17/31 chosen on SELECT.
learners.O4_PUBLIC_LAGGED_COUNTS: Verbatim original O4 fitted public-history lagged count baseline, same TRAIN, fitted SELECT/DEV roles
learners.O4_PUBLIC_CURRENT_COUNTS: Verbatim original O4 fitted public current-only count baseline, same TRAIN
learners.ERASE_FULL_BELIEF_STATE: Reuses selected and TRAINED FULL_CREDIT_BELIEF checkpoint but resets predicted prior to 0.5 before EVERY public observation when evaluating DEV, not retrained.

frozen_training.initialization: Python Random(seed).uniform(-.20,.20) added to five fixed logits (-1.2,+1.2,-2.0,-1.0,0.0) respectively
frozen_training.fit_order: Every epoch, 48 TRAIN episodes ascending index in contiguous minibatches of 8; one Adam update per minibatch
frozen_training.selection: Best SELECT next-public-bit mean NLL among starts17/31 only, seed17 wins tie; no DEV selection/tuning
frozen_training.count_and_hmm: Fit on identical TRAIN with 12 original HMM EM rounds and fitted count tables, HMM restart selected solely SELECT

evaluation.metric: Mean next PUBLIC bit NLL over all O13_PUBLIC_DEV transitions; lower better; report all seven arms and null signed differences
evaluation.causal_ablation: STOP_CREDIT_BELIEF minus FULL_CREDIT_BELIEF; positive supports full recurrent gradient, not automatically learned general intelligence
evaluation.transition_ablation: FROZEN_TRANSITION_BELIEF minus FULL_CREDIT_BELIEF; positive supports learned action-transition update
evaluation.state_erasure: ERASE_FULL_BELIEF_STATE minus FULL_CREDIT_BELIEF; positive supports internal belief memory
evaluation.baseline: Compare against minimum fitted original O4 HMM and current/lagged counts, not just weaker ablations
evaluation.cost: Fit+SELECT CPU including both restarts; DEV inference CPU; all five logits and Adam moments in checkpoint; model state bytes; source generation CPU; whole-process peak RSS and Python memory
evaluation.source_repro: All 4 families×3 role SHA256 public source identities exact Windows/Linux
evaluation.numeric_repro: All 4×7 DEV mean NLL values within 1e-6 Windows/Linux; fail closed with separate comparison job
evaluation.positivity: NO automatic GO from public DEV; require improvement over strongest trained comparator with comparable full resource budgets, independent first-use/unknown family transfer, null robustness and ablations before any integration

guardrails: No existing O1-O12 role, DEV, protected original/HELD/Q21/Q21N01 episodes used
No hidden latent features, generator law or family labels passed to any learner; history actions observable to all
No external controller, FORGE science queue, native Wingless/Yggdrasil, KTRADE, Cloudflare, paid API or broker actions
Protocol Git blob and O4 original control blob immutable, new branch from protected main, additive source-only draft
Preserve all negatives including cross-platform qualification failures; never re-run already inspected O13_DEV as new independent science
